observation.command:
cd /opt/mapserver
# MapServer uses GDAL VFS to read from S3. Set env vars for AWS/S3.
cat > /opt/mapserver/env.sh <<'EOF'
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=xplanbox
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=xplanbox
export AWS_REGION=eu-central-1
export AWS_S3_ENDPOINT_WITHOUT_PROTOCOL=127.0.0.1:9000
export AWS_HTTPS=NO
export AWS_VIRTUAL_HOSTING=NO
export XPLAN_S3_BUCKET_ATTACHMENTS=xplan-attachments
export XPLAN_MAPSERVER_URL_PUBLIC=http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wms/services/wms
export XPLAN_SERVICES_PROVIDER_NAME=xPlanBox
export XPLAN_SERVICES_PROVIDER_CONTACT_NAME=xPlanBox
export XPLAN_SERVICES_PROVIDER_CONTACT_POSITIONNAME=xPlanBox
export XPLAN_SERVICES_WMS_MAXWIDTH=4096
export XPLAN_MAPSERVER_ON_MISSING_DATA=TRUE
EOF
source /opt/mapserver/env.sh
# Create ms4w temp dir
mkdir -p /opt/mapserver/ms4w/tmp/ms_tmp /opt/mapserver/tmp/ms_tmp
# Test that mapserver can load the mapfile
mapserv -v >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "mapserv ok"
# Test the map file parses
python3 -c "print('checking mapfile syntax')"; 
shp2img -m /opt/mapserver/mapserver.map -o /tmp/test_map.png -e 2>&1 | head -5 || true
